description: Per-case Jev P(threat) over the same 167 golden states, one file per run, in the record shape of ../jev_triage_results.json. Plotted by notebooks/benchmark_analytics.py (Jev release comparison). 'headline' runs request each release by name on the paid first-party API, two runs per release, so the between-release difference can be read against the within-release noise. 'history' runs are shown on request. Context: docs/adr/0008-jev-transport-vercel-gateway-to-typesafe-api.md.
